bluetooth_confirm.title: Mi Band discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Set up {name} ({address})?

The band must no longer be connected to the Zepp Life phone app (revoke its Bluetooth access, but do not unpair the band).

manual_address.title: Band address
manual_address.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the band (shown in Zepp Life or in the band settings).

key.title: Authentication key
key.description: The band only accepts connections that know its pairing key. It can be fetched automatically from the Zepp account, or entered by hand.

menu_options.zepp: Fetch the key with my Zepp account

zepp.title: Zepp account
zepp.description: Credentials of the Zepp / Zepp Life account the band {address} is paired with (email and password sign-in). They are only used to fetch the key and are not stored.

manual_key.title: Enter the key
manual_key.description: 32 hexadecimal characters key of the band {address}, with or without the 0x prefix (for example obtained with huami-token).

error.invalid_auth: Zepp credentials rejected. Accounts signed in with Google or Xiaomi are not supported: enter the key by hand.
error.cannot_connect: The Zepp cloud cannot be reached, try again later.
error.device_not_found: No key found for this band on this account. Check that it was paired and synced with this account, or enter the key by hand.

data.set_time: Set the band clock to Home Assistant time

data_description.scan_interval: Each sync connects to the band then disconnects. A short interval uses a bit more of the band battery.
data_description.set_time: Useful since the phone no longer syncs the band clock.
